resources.string: Use archive templates supplied by your provider. Up to three addresses, tried after the normal address. The channel configuration overrides the playlist. Use {utc} or {start}, {end} or {duration}, {streamId}, {username} and {password}. This does not create missing recordings.
Use valid HTTP/HTTPS archive addresses with start and end/duration placeholders. Saving failed or an address is invalid.
To include these addresses in a backup, use password protection.
